headline: US Official: "No Approval, Tolls or Costs Needed for Temporary Hormuz Route"
summary: A US official said no approval, tolls or costs will be needed for a temporary route in the Strait of Hormuz. Free passage for all merchant ships would be guaranteed once it is established.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for seaborne crude oil and LNG shipments from the Gulf. Shipping access there directly affects global energy supply.
why_moved: A promise of free, toll-free passage for merchant ships through Hormuz addresses shipping disruption risk for global oil flows.
